title: MV Quest for the Q4 Numbers (Comedy D&D inspired story)

posts.author: sarriest
posts.body:
Quest for the Q4 Numbers
A fan made game for Season 1 of Offices & Bosses, from the podcast Hello from the Magic Tavern.
Play the game in your browser here.
Synopsis
Spoiler
The Midwest Regional COO Roz Walters is in town... and she's not happy.
John Bastion, Dan Smith, Gail Davidson-Durst, and Orlando Bloom have been tasked to compile and submit the Q4 numbers before the End of Business day. What kind of crazy shenanigans will they get up to?
Features
Comedy D&D inspired story (you
will
laugh!)
~3 hours of gameplay
30+ different maps
60+ Easter eggs
SPOILER ALERT: This game is based off Season 1 of Offices & Bosses, from the podcast Hello from the Magic Tavern.​
It can be played without listening to the podcast, but some context to make it less confusing:
Main podcast -
an Earth man (Arnie) fell through a portal into a fantasy world (Foon) and becomes good friends with a shapeshifter who's almost always a badger (Chunt) and a very loud wizard (Usidore).
Offices & Bosses spinoff -
the 3 of them play Foon's version of D&D, which has a setting of... this mundane real world of ours.
This game follows their first "actual play" campaign - most of the in game dialogue comes straight from the actors' mouths. To best enjoy it, I recommend listening to Season 1 of Offices & Bosses (~4.5h) first:
main website
or
Patreon (filter by 2023)
.
Note that the podcast contains mature themes, but those have been intentionally left out of the game to adhere to the MPA PG-13 standard.
There is a single mention of the word "sex", a few mentions of the word "sh*t", and a bunch of blood spots in the cafe map after the human enemies are defeated.
DISCLAIMER​
This game is a fan-made creation and not officially endorsed or affiliated with the Hello from the Magic Tavern podcast or its creators.
It is created for entertainment purposes only and is not intended for commercial use or profit.
